name: PMP Certification Preparation
certifications: PMI Project Management Professional (PMP), exam based on the July 2026 Examination Content Outline
35 contact hours of project management education are required before applying
Related: PMI Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
tools: Practice question bank such as PMI Study Hall

beginner.summary: For project managers starting PMP preparation. Covers eligibility and the application, the July 2026 exam format and Examination Content Outline, the PMBOK Guide Eighth Edition, predictive, agile and hybrid approaches, life cycles and tailoring, integrated planning, scope, schedule, finance, quality, resources and procurement, stakeholders, communication, risk, team leadership, agile practices, earned value and how to read situational questions, ending with a diagnostic mock exam.
prerequisites: Has led or directed projects, or will soon meet PMI's experience requirement
Has completed or is completing 35 contact hours of project management education
Can study for several hours each week outside the sessions
outcomes: Explain the exam format, domains and eligibility rules and prepare a complete application
Apply the core concepts of predictive, agile and hybrid project management to exam questions
Calculate earned value and schedule results used in the exam
Answer situational questions using a repeatable method and follow a personal study plan

days.topic: PMP Certification Overview: Eligibility, Application and the July 2026 Exam
subtopics: What the PMP certifies and who it suits
Eligibility routes: education, project experience and 35 contact hours
Writing project experience descriptions for the application
The application audit and how to prepare for it
Exam fees, PMI membership and scheduling
The new exam from 9 July 2026: 180 questions in 240 minutes
Optional breaks and how the clock works
How this course and the study plan fit together
days.lab_task: Check your eligibility against the current PMI rules, write two project experience descriptions in the format the application expects, and draft a twelve-week study plan with weekly hours.
days.deliverable: Eligibility check, two experience descriptions and a study plan
checks: Education, experience and contact hours are checked against current PMI rules
Each description covers objective, role, responsibilities and outcome
The plan has weekly hours and a target exam date

days.topic: The Examination Content Outline: Domains, Tasks and Enablers
subtopics: Why the content outline, not a single book, defines the exam
Domain weights: People 33%, Process 41%, Business Environment 26%
What moved into Business Environment in 2026
Predictive, agile and hybrid content across domains
Turning the outline into a study checklist
days.lab_task: Turn the content outline into a personal checklist, rate your confidence on every task, and plan which tasks need the most study time.
days.deliverable: Rated content outline checklist
checks: Every task in the outline appears in the checklist
Each task has a confidence rating from one to five
The lowest-rated tasks have extra study time in the plan
objectives: Map questions to domains and tasks

days.topic: PMBOK Guide Eighth Edition: Principles, Performance Domains and Focus Areas
subtopics: How the Eighth Edition differs from the Sixth and Seventh
The five focus areas and the processes inside them
How the guide supports, but does not replace, the content outline
Using the guide as a reference while studying
days.lab_task: Build a one-page mind map that links the principles, performance domains and focus areas, and write flashcards for twenty key terms from the guide.
days.deliverable: One-page mind map and twenty flashcards
checks: The mind map shows how principles, domains and focus areas connect
Five sample questions are answered using the mind map
objectives: Explain the PMBOK Guide Eighth Edition structure
Use the guide as a reference

days.topic: Predictive, Agile and Hybrid Delivery Approaches
subtopics: Predictive delivery and when it fits
Agile delivery and when it fits
How the exam signals which approach a scenario uses
days.lab_task: Choose a delivery approach for six short project cases using a selection grid, justify each choice, and answer fifteen approach-selection practice questions.
days.deliverable: Six approach decisions and practice results
checks: Each case has an approach with at least two reasons
Scenario wording that signals the approach is highlighted
At least eleven of fifteen practice questions are correct
objectives: Choose an approach for a scenario

days.topic: Project Life Cycles, Phases and Tailoring
subtopics: Project, product and development life cycles
Tailoring for size, risk and regulation
Organisational process assets and enterprise environmental factors
Project management offices and their types
The project manager's sphere of influence
days.lab_task: Design and justify a tailored life cycle for a regulated software project and a small marketing project, and answer fifteen tailoring and life cycle questions.
days.deliverable: Two tailored life cycles and practice results
checks: Each life cycle shows phases and the reasons for tailoring choices
Environmental factors and process assets are identified for each case
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Integration: The Project Management Plan and Delivery Planning
subtopics: The project management plan and its parts
Integrating plans across scope, schedule and cost
days.lab_task: Write a charter and an outline project management plan for a case, identify the baselines and answer fifteen integration questions with written reasoning for each.
days.deliverable: Charter, plan outline and reasoned answers
checks: The charter has objectives, high-level scope, sponsor and authority
Scope, schedule and cost baselines are defined
Each answer cites the concept behind it

days.topic: Scope: Requirements, WBS and Backlogs
subtopics: Work breakdown structure and WBS dictionary
Definition of done and acceptance criteria
Scope questions in predictive and agile settings
days.lab_task: Build a WBS for a predictive case and a prioritised backlog with acceptance criteria for an agile case, then answer fifteen scope questions.
days.deliverable: WBS, backlog and practice results
checks: The WBS reaches work packages with a dictionary for three of them
Backlog items have acceptance criteria and a definition of done
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Schedule: Networks, Critical Path and Release Plans
subtopics: Critical path, float and the forward and backward pass
Schedule compression: crashing and fast tracking
days.lab_task: Draw a network for twelve activities, calculate early and late dates, float and the critical path, build a release plan from a velocity, and solve ten schedule calculation questions.
days.deliverable: Network diagram with calculations, release plan and practice results
checks: Critical path and float are correct
The release plan matches the stated velocity
At least eight of ten calculation questions are correct

days.topic: Cost and Finance: Estimates, Budgets and Funding Limits
subtopics: Estimating methods: analogous, parametric and bottom-up
days.lab_task: Estimate a case project with two methods, build a cost baseline with reserves, compare two projects by NPV and payback, and answer fifteen finance questions.
days.deliverable: Estimate, cost baseline, project comparison and practice results
checks: Both methods are applied with stated assumptions
Contingency is inside the baseline and management reserve outside it
NPV and payback are calculated correctly

days.topic: Quality for the Exam: Planning, Assurance, Control and Cost of Quality
subtopics: Cost of quality: prevention, appraisal and failure
Quality tools: cause-and-effect, Pareto and control charts

days.deliverable: Charts, cost of quality table and practice results
checks: Out-of-control points and the main defect causes are identified
Each cost is classed as prevention, appraisal or failure
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Resources and Procurement: Teams, Materials and Contracts
subtopics: Resource planning and the RACI chart
Contract types: fixed price, cost reimbursable and time and materials
days.lab_task: Build a RACI for a case, make a make-or-buy decision with figures, choose contract types for three procurement scenarios and answer fifteen questions.
days.deliverable: RACI, make-or-buy decision, contract choices and practice results
checks: Each activity has exactly one accountable person
Each contract type matches the scenario's risk and scope clarity
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Stakeholders: Identification, Analysis and Engagement
days.lab_task: Build a stakeholder register and power-interest grid for a case, set current and desired engagement levels and actions, and answer fifteen stakeholder questions.
days.deliverable: Stakeholder register, grid, engagement plan and practice results
checks: Each stakeholder is placed on the grid with a reason
Gaps between current and desired engagement have actions
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Communication Planning and Information Radiators
subtopics: Information radiators and big visible charts
days.lab_task: Write a communication plan for a case with twelve stakeholders, calculate communication channels, design an information radiator and answer fifteen communication questions.
days.deliverable: Communication plan, radiator design and practice results
checks: Each stakeholder group has content, frequency and method
The channel count is calculated correctly
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Risk: Identification, Analysis and Responses
subtopics: Risk owners and the risk register
days.lab_task: Identify risks for a case, analyse them on a probability and impact matrix, plan responses for threats and opportunities, and answer fifteen risk questions.
days.deliverable: Risk register with responses and practice results
checks: Each risk has probability, impact and an owner
Threats and opportunities have the correct response types
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Leading the Project Team: Vision, Servant Leadership and Empowerment
subtopics: Empowering the team and delegating decisions
days.lab_task: Write a team charter and vision statement for a case team, choose leadership responses to six team situations, and answer fifteen leadership questions.
days.deliverable: Team charter, vision statement, situation responses and practice results
checks: The vision statement links the team's work to the project goal
Responses support the team rather than direct it
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Agile Practices: Scrum Events, Kanban and User Stories
subtopics: User stories and estimation with story points
Agile practice questions on the exam
days.lab_task: Run a simulated two-iteration project with a Kanban board, estimate stories with points, hold a review and retrospective, and answer fifteen agile practice questions.
days.deliverable: Board snapshots, iteration notes and practice results
checks: Both iterations include planning, review and retrospective notes
The board shows WIP limits being respected
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Earned Value Management and the Formulas to Know
subtopics: Planned value, earned value and actual cost
Estimate at completion and its variants
Estimate to complete and variance at completion
Earned value questions under time pressure
days.lab_task: Calculate earned value results for three case projects, interpret what each result means for the project, and solve twenty earned value questions against the clock.
days.deliverable: Calculations, interpretations and timed practice results
checks: All variances and indexes are correct
Each result is explained as ahead, behind, over or under
At least sixteen of twenty questions are correct within thirty minutes

days.topic: Reading PMP Questions: Situational Question Strategy
subtopics: Finding what the question really asks
Spotting the delivery approach in the scenario
What a project manager should do first or next
Eliminating answers that escalate too early or skip analysis
Answers that break the PMI Code of Ethics
Multiple response, matching and hotspot questions
days.lab_task: Answer thirty situational questions using the strategy card, write the reason for every wrong answer in an error log and identify your three most common error types.
days.deliverable: Answered questions and an error log with three error types
checks: Every answer shows the elimination steps
Every wrong answer has a reason in the error log
Three error types are identified with examples

days.topic: Mixed Domain Practice Set with Detailed Review
subtopics: Mixed questions from all three domains
Reviewing correct answers as well as wrong ones
Linking each question to an outline task
Building a list of terms to revise
days.lab_task: Answer sixty mixed questions in seventy-five minutes, review every question with its outline task, update your confidence ratings and change next week's study plan.
days.deliverable: Practice results, updated checklist and revised study plan
checks: Sixty questions are answered within seventy-five minutes
Each reviewed question is linked to an outline task
The plan changes based on the results

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: First Diagnostic Mock Exam and Study Plan
days.lab_task: Sit a timed diagnostic mock exam of at least ninety questions, analyse results by domain and error type, and produce a revised study plan with a target exam date and a completed application draft.
days.deliverable: Mock exam results, analysis, revised plan and application draft
checks: The mock is completed under timed conditions
Results are broken down by domain with error types
The revised plan targets the weakest domain first
objectives: Plan the next stage of study

intermediate.summary: For candidates who know the core concepts and need to reach exam standard. Works through the July 2026 content outline domain by domain with situational practice: vision and conflict, team performance, stakeholders and communication, distributed teams, knowledge transfer, integrated planning and value-based delivery, scope, schedule, finance and procurement, quality and status, closure, governance and compliance, change control, risk and issues, impediments and improvement, organisational and external change, AI and sustainability scenarios, hybrid choices and a full-length mock exam.
prerequisites: Has completed beginner PMP preparation or equivalent study
Scores at least fifty percent on a diagnostic mock exam
Has submitted or drafted the PMP application
outcomes: Answer situational questions across all three domains at exam standard
Handle Business Environment questions on governance, compliance, change and risk
Choose and combine predictive, agile and hybrid practices in scenarios
Complete a full-length mock exam and target remaining gaps

days.deliverable: Scenario decisions, team agreement and practice results

The team agreement covers communication, decisions and conflict
At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.deliverable: Case diagnoses, chosen actions and practice results

days.deliverable: Case decisions, updated matrix and practice results
checks: The first action in each case addresses the root cause

checks: The agreement covers time zones, tools and response times

days.topic: Process Domain in Depth: Integrated Planning and Value-Based Delivery
subtopics: Integrated planning across all parts of the plan

days.lab_task: Build an integrated delivery plan for a hybrid case that releases value early, prioritise features by value and answer twenty planning and value questions.
days.deliverable: Delivery plan, prioritised features and practice results
checks: The plan aligns scope, schedule, cost and resources

At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.lab_task: Handle four scope scenarios (unclear requirements, a new feature request, gold plating and a failed acceptance), prioritise a backlog and answer twenty scope questions.
days.deliverable: Scenario responses, prioritised backlog and practice results
checks: Each scenario response follows the right process for the approach
The backlog is ordered with stated reasons
At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.topic: Schedule Compression, Resource Levelling and Agile Velocity
subtopics: Resource levelling and its effect on the critical path
days.lab_task: Recover a delayed schedule in a case by choosing between crashing and fast tracking with costs, forecast completion from velocity data and solve twenty schedule questions.
days.deliverable: Recovery plan, forecast and practice results
checks: The chosen option meets the deadline at the lowest stated cost
The completion forecast matches the velocity data
At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.topic: Finance and Procurement: Contracts, Make-or-Buy and Budget Control
days.lab_task: Handle five procurement and budget scenarios (a seller delay, a claim, a cost overrun, a contract choice and a closure), and answer twenty finance and procurement questions.
days.deliverable: Scenario responses and practice results
checks: The seller scenario follows the contract terms
The overrun response uses forecasts and options
At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.topic: Quality and Project Status: Metrics, Dashboards and Reporting
subtopics: Reporting to sponsors and governance bodies
Status and quality tasks in the outline
days.lab_task: Build a project status dashboard from sample data with quality and schedule measures, interpret the trends and answer twenty status and quality questions.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, trend notes and practice results
checks: The dashboard shows status, trends and thresholds
Trend notes state what needs action
At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.topic: Project Closure and Transition to Operations
days.lab_task: Close a case project with a closure checklist, transition plan and final report, handle an early termination scenario and answer fifteen closure questions.
days.deliverable: Closure checklist, transition plan, final report and practice results
checks: Acceptance, contracts and resources are all closed
The transition plan names receiving owners
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Business Environment in Depth: Governance and Compliance
subtopics: Governance in agile and hybrid projects
Governance and compliance tasks in the outline
days.lab_task: Design a governance structure and compliance register for a regulated case project, and answer twenty governance and compliance questions.
days.deliverable: Governance structure, compliance register and practice results
checks: Decision rights and escalation paths are clear
Each requirement has an owner and evidence
At least fifteen of twenty questions are correct

days.topic: Integrated Change Control and Agile Change
subtopics: Change in agile projects: the backlog and the product owner
Unauthorised changes and how to respond
Change tasks in the Business Environment domain
days.lab_task: Process three change requests through impact analysis and a change board, handle an unauthorised change scenario and answer twenty change questions.
days.deliverable: Change requests with decisions and practice results
checks: Each change request shows scope, schedule, cost and risk impact
Decisions are made by the right authority

subtopics: Risk in the Business Environment domain

days.deliverable: Updated risk register, issue log and practice results
checks: The register shows updated ratings and owners
Occurred risks become issues with workarounds or contingency

subtopics: The project manager as an impediment remover

days.deliverable: Retrospective outcomes, improvement actions and practice results
checks: The retrospective produces specific improvement actions
Each impediment has an owner and a resolution
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Organisational Change and External Environment Changes
subtopics: Organisational change and its effect on projects
External changes: regulation, market and technology
Assessing the impact of external change
Organisational and external change scenario questions

days.deliverable: Readiness assessment, impact response and practice results
checks: Readiness is rated for each user group
The response updates scope, risk and plan

Using AI tools in project work responsibly
Data privacy and ethics with AI
Balancing sustainability with scope, cost and schedule
Stakeholder expectations on AI and sustainability
days.lab_task: Decide responsibly how a case team should use AI tools for reporting and estimation, assess the sustainability impact of two design options, and answer fifteen scenario questions.

days.topic: Hybrid Project Scenarios: Choosing and Combining Approaches
subtopics: Signals that a project needs a hybrid approach
Combining predictive governance with agile delivery
days.lab_task: Design a hybrid approach for a case with fixed regulatory milestones and changing software features, and answer twenty-five hybrid scenario questions with written reasoning.
days.deliverable: Hybrid approach design and practice results
checks: Fixed milestones and agile delivery are combined clearly

At least nineteen of twenty-five questions are correct

days.topic: Full-Length Timed Mock Exam and Review
days.lab_task: Sit a full 180-question mock exam in 240 minutes with the two optional breaks, then review every wrong answer by domain, task and error type.
days.deliverable: Mock exam result, error analysis and priorities
checks: All 180 questions are answered within the time
Wrong answers are grouped by domain, task and error type

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Domain Gap Analysis and Targeted Practice Plan
days.lab_task: Combine all practice results and the mock exam into a gap analysis by domain and task, build a four-week targeted practice plan and decide whether to book the exam.
days.deliverable: Gap analysis, targeted plan and exam date decision
checks: Every task with low scores is identified
The plan spends most time on the weakest tasks
The exam date decision is justified by the results
objectives: Decide when to sit the exam

advanced.summary: For candidates in the final weeks before the exam, experienced project managers aiming for a high score and candidates retaking the exam. Covers the hardest situational questions, case-based question sets, the agile mindset, complex stakeholders, procurement edge cases, calculations under time pressure, quantitative risk, ethics, benefits and value, tailoring decisions, distractors, pacing for 240 minutes, three further mock exams, domain sprints, final revision and exam-day rules.
prerequisites: Has completed intermediate PMP preparation or equivalent study
Scores at least sixty-five percent on full-length mock exams
Has an approved application or a booked exam
outcomes: Score consistently above target on full-length mock exams
Answer the hardest situational and case-based questions with a reliable method
Manage time, energy and exam-day rules confidently
Make an evidence-based decision on exam readiness

checks: Each case is completed within the time limit
